input.subject: Monkey D. Luffy
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Approved design direction: long-range direct melee contact using stretched fists, not traveling ammunition. Base Gum-Gum Pistol roughly 45 reach. The ONLY three upgrade paths are Conqueror Haki, Observation Haki, Armament Haki. Shared form access based on highest tier on ANY path: Gear Second at 1, Gear Third at 2, Gear Fourth variants Boundman/Snakeman/Tankman at 3, Gear Fifth at 5. Base is not Gear First. Provide different replacement attack profiles and a contextual Technique for these forms; research named moves. Gear II+III is a contextual Technique replacement after tier 2, not simultaneous forms. One shared bounded stamina resource, recovery in base, positive drain in Gears, reentry delay and shared Technique cooldown. Conqueror controls weak-willed stunnable enemies then coating; Observation detects concealed enemies and improves reach/targeting/cadence; Armament hardening, armor penetration, emission/internal damage. Explicitly disclose selectable Tankman without a feeding prerequisite as game adaptation, and bounded Fifth rubberization rather than unrestricted reality alteration. Preserve all these design decisions, research whether individual move names are supported. Use the six-page targeted Gear research to preserve canon Wano named moves: Bajrang Gun for Fifth, distinct Fourth attacks and Gigant Jet Shell as the contextual Second+Third combination. Dawn Whip, Dawn Gatling and the later named Star Gun are outside the cutoff. Base Pistol is available from initial placement; Technique controls remain unavailable in base. Shared resources unlock at tier1; no invented base Technique. For Fourth distinguish Boundman power, Snakeman changing-path rapid punches and Stuffed Tankman recoil. Keep Tankman feeding/recoil departures explicit, since hostile tower strikes are not simulated. Contextual Technique cooldown is shared, not one independent button per named move.

context.cutoff: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
context.coverage: Character-specific capabilities are requirements to verify, not evidence. Record unsupported facts as gaps. No old generated artifacts supplied.

knowledge.subject: Monkey D. Luffy
gaps: All six supplied captures were considered through their endings, including later ability sections, references, situational techniques and navigation. Each reports acquisitionTruncated=false. Only supplied text was available: linked manga chapters, images, supplementary publications and other technique pages were not independently inspected.

The evidence is chiefly fan-wiki prose or wikitext, supplemented by the ONE PIECE.com Wano summary. Embedded chapter references support temporal filtering but are not separately acquired sources or independent verification of every interpretation.

The continuity is explicitly requested, so no default-continuity assumption is needed. General character facts were resolved from the character-specific abilities page rather than from the navigation lists or an unprovided standalone biography.

Post-Wano material is excluded, including Egghead and Elbaph battles, hearing Emet, later Haki interactions with immortality, Domi Reversi immunity claims, isolated Mini Gear Four, and the manga Elephant Whip introduced in Chapter 1127. Later navigation entries do not expand the selected record.

Gear 5's later named repertoire is excluded: Mole Pistol, Dawn Whip, Dawn Rocket, Dawn Stamp, the named Star Gun execution, Dawn Gatling, Dawn Cymbal, Dawn Balloon, Dawn Pistol, Tummy Cracker, Gear 5 Jet Gatling, Genie, Caught-You-Slipping Bullet, Dawn Kraken Gatling, Dawn Thor Rifle and Dawn Thor Bullet. The Wano precursor associated retrospectively with Star Gun is retained only as an unnamed attack.

Adaptation-only and game-only techniques and variants are not merged into manga evidence. This includes the anime Jet Lance naming, Jet Missile, Jet Rifle and Jet Axe uses; later anime-only Hawk attacks; game Red Hawk upgrades, Eagle Storm and Gigant Jet Gatling; Giant Fly Swatter, Grizzly Corkscrew Magnum, film Thor attacks, One Piece Party situational moves, Leo Rex Bazooka, King King King Kong Gun, King Kong Gatling, Rhino Stampede, Dragon Culverin, Counterblow and licensed-game Gear 5 finishers.

The pages' broad descriptions of Gear 5 turning anything imagined into reality rely partly on their interpretation of Road To Laugh Tale. They also qualify object creation as uncertain and the power as non-omnipotent. This record retains demonstrated Wano rubberization, shape changes and cartoonish physical effects, not unrestricted reality alteration or permanent object creation.

Some summaries reverse the fruit-name chronology or retain Paramecia labels in navigation. The character page's explicit Wano revelation supports Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika as the true Mythical Zoan identity and Gomu Gomu no Mi as the previously used name.

Gear 2 lifespan loss is presented more categorically in some summary wording than in the detailed page's attribution to Lucci's speculation. No quantified Gear 2 lifespan loss is established. Similarly, later improvements do not justify erasing Gear 4's explicitly retained Onigashima time limit and Haki exhaustion.

The detailed Gear 4 page distinguishes the demonstrated Tankman: Stuffed Version from an unknown ordinary Tankman. The main page's generic Tankman summary cannot establish an additional observed unstuffed form.

The Gear 5 page supports cutting vulnerability and taxing use, but several detailed claims about aged appearance, recovery after deactivation, food-based immediate restoration and awakened Zoan personality takeover cite post-Wano chapters. Those later explanations are not backdated as established Wano facts.

The supplied pages do not give a systematic account of swimming inability or water-submersion thresholds. Their mention of balloon buoyancy and navigation links to the Blue Sea is insufficient to reconstruct those mechanics. No unsupported memory-based water rules are added.
The Thor Elephant Gun page calls its sparks lightning enhancement but does not establish a general ability to generate or control electricity. Its film-only Thor Axe comparison is excluded.

The main page's Nightmare Luffy skin-color reference appears internally malformed, and the supplied text mixes manga and anime color evidence. The core borrowed-shadow transformation is retained without depending on that color citation.

A complete baseline Gomu Gomu technique page was not supplied. Numerous original attacks are identified indirectly through Gear variants, but unsupported detailed descriptions of every baseline move are not reconstructed. No user guidance requested additional features, and allowUnverified=false prevents adding memory-based claims.

findings.message: Pulse and emission cycles count successful primary attack cycles required for one trigger, not waves per trigger. A cycle counts once when at least one primary hit applies positive damage, regardless of collateral targets. Pulses apply stun without damage; their event amount counts affected targets. Emissions apply their declared damage. Pulse intervals can further limit trigger frequency.

gaps: This is a bounded review of the supplied passages, chiefly fan-wiki prose and wikitext plus an official Wano summary. Linked manga pages, images and supplementary publications were not independently inspected.
The baseline Pistol is identified indirectly through its Gear variants; the supplied evidence does not include a complete baseline technique article.

Snakeman's changing paths and acceleration are defining source properties but are explicitly omitted from execution. Fast contacts and a locked-target barrage should not be presented elsewhere as actual homing or curved-path simulation.

Tankman removes feeding, incoming attacks, trapping and enemy-projectile collisions; Gigant Jet Shell removes unit travel; Bajrang Gun removes source scale and abstracts noncontact delivery. These are disclosed adaptations rather than literal reproductions.
The Fifth slow represents bodily rubberization through a game status. The sources establish bodily stretching, not the selected speed multiplier, duration or a universal canon slowing rule.

Shared stamina does not reproduce each Gear's canonical drawback. In particular, purchased Haki remaining active after Fourth exhaustion is a disclosed replacement of the source restriction, not a supported Wano development.

The candidate explicitly omits defensive rubber properties, lightning immunity, poison resistance, defensive combat, flight and traversal, food healing, Seastone interactions, Voice of All Things, borrowed Nightmare abilities, improvised equipment and lightning throwing. These traits are not implemented by its damage or range values.
Prices, numerical balance, unlock tiers, caps and lifecycle timings are provisional game choices. Source support does not establish measured balance or enjoyable play.
